resources.string: DM opens Instagram’s recipient picker. Enable SAO for Instagram in an API-102 LSPosed framework to send photos directly.
Open Instagram once to enable DM attachments, then reopen this picker.
Attach this media in an Instagram direct message
Paste this photo into the original Instagram conversation using LSPosed; sends immediately
Paste sends the photo directly to the open DM. DM lets you choose a recipient.
Instagram’s native keyboard handler supports still photos. Use DM for GIFs and videos.
Instagram accepted the photo send request.
